title: Don T NDE 3181
content: I was being wheeled down the hallway to my room after a lengthy registration period by a somewhat indifferent Catholic sister/nurse. I was a Protestant and this; the closest hospital (and Catholic) didn't want to accept us. I was fading and getting weaker and weaker by the moment. The nurse was pushing me along the hallway in a wheelchair with my mother following close behind. My mother was getting frantic, because of my worsening appearance, while the nurse seemed to be taking her time. Suddenly I slumped in my chair, moaned and my conscious self 'lifted' out of my body leaving the chair. I floated above the nurse and my mother at about the level of the high hallway ceiling. I saw the thoughts of them both; the nurse thought she would be fired and my mother thought I died and what would people think of her. She was/is a loving mother and that was her immediate thought. I continued floating upward and became a little frightened. I noticed I was curled up and that I felt very good (much better than when I was in the chair). Finally, I realized I was in the presence of some beings that were very loving. While there seemed to be a main being, the others were free to communicate also. I was shown the history of the planet and other things that I lost almost immediately. I think I remember asking if I could tell people about the secrets I'd seen. They made me understand that I would forget the secrets very quickly (and I did). I then was told that I could stay with them if I liked and have a 'rest' but that I wasn't finished. They said if I stayed, I would have to go back eventually. I understood this as going back in another body and starting all over. I told them I would go back and immediately felt being drawn back down to the chair where my body was waiting. I got back into my body much like putting on a coat of stiff old clothes. It was very painful and my body felt terrible. I lifted my finger to signal that I was okay.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt 'lifted' out of body; noticed being curled up; felt very good and floated upward.

arrival.other_being_detail: Described as 'some beings that were very loving' with a 'main being' and others who could communicate.

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Protestant (mentions being Protestant; hospital staff were Catholic).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Telepathic awareness of nurse's and mother's thoughts; shown 'history of the planet and other things.'
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE in hallway, then upward floating and encounter with loving beings and knowledge, then choice/being told could stay but not finished, then return to body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Perceived the thoughts of the nurse and mother during the OBE; beings offered a 'rest' and implied eventual return 'in another body and starting all over.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “my conscious self 'lifted' out of my body”; “I saw the thoughts of them both”; “I was shown the history of the planet”; “I would forget the secrets very quickly”; “I could stay with them if I liked and have a 'rest' but that I wasn't finished”; “going back in another body and starting all over”; “much like putting on a coat of stiff old clothes.”
